purpose: Reconstruct the final recorded development-exposure boundary before fresh final split construction.
claim_boundary: EXP017 is superseded as a final split; only its TRAIN and DEV memberships are retained as development exposure.
Historical EXP017 TEST membership is not automatically treated as development exposure.
The legacy exclusion list is unioned with EXP017 TRAIN and DEV by exact video ID.
Later metadata is checked only for explicit video-ID fields; no exposure ID is inferred from metrics, counts, filenames or absence of fields.
Any later explicit video ID outside the reconstructed boundary must be reported for review before final split lock.
This experiment does not define DI-v1 and does not construct a DEV or TEST split.
No SAM, gate, POR, fresh final DEV or TEST evaluation is performed.
The unresolved historical P2 reference remains explicit; no IDs are fabricated.
